summary: Frontend-only testing of Parcours A 'Liste des obligations' refactor: guided questions (faits + précisions) replacing verdict dropdown across non-U6 obligations. Login OK with provided Régime A credentials, navigated to Parcours A → Liste des obligations, verified guided questions render, save persists as 'Documenté — à valider', preuve upload/delete OK, U6 unchanged, U4/U5 rappels unchanged. Non-regression on Profil, Gantt Parcours A and Kanban Parcours B all pass.

issues: U1 card still displays legacy 'Conforme' badge from a pre-refactor save (parcours_a_traites=4/17). Since verdict selector no longer exists, a user cannot easily 'downgrade' the badge back to 'Documenté — à valider' without a data migration. Not caused by the current change (auto-marking works correctly for new saves), but worth mentioning: consider a one-time backend migration to reset legacy statut='conforme' to 'a_valider' for consistency with the new philosophy 'l'outil documente, il ne juge pas'.

action_items: (Optional) One-time migration to convert legacy 'conforme' statuses on non-U6 obligations to 'a_valider' so that pre-existing dossiers reflect the new documentation-only philosophy.

STATUTS array in ParcoursAElements.jsx still contains 'conforme' / 'non_conforme' labels — kept only for backward display of legacy data. OK, but tag with a comment.
